<style>

.timeline-6-list {
	width: var(--width-l);
	margin: 0 auto;
	position: relative;
  gap: var(--content-gap);
}


.timeline-6-list > li {
	padding: var(--space-m);
	background-color: var(--primary);
	color: var(--white);
	border-radius: var(--radius-m);
	margin-bottom: var(--space-m);
  gap:var(--content-gap);
}
.timeline-6-list > li:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}
.timeline-6-card h3 {
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: var(--h3);
}
.timeline-6-card p {
	font-size: var(--text-m);
}
.timeline-6-card .timeline-6-card__date {
	font-size: var(--text-s);
	font-weight: 400;
	letter-spacing: 1px;
}
@media only screen and (min-width: 768px) {
	.timeline-6-list:before {
		content: "";
		position: absolute;
		top: .8rem;
		left: 50%;
		transform: translateX(-50%);
		width: .2rem;
		height: 100%;
		background-color: var(--primary-light);
	}
	.timeline-6-list > li {
		width: 50%;
		position: relative;
	}
	.timeline-6-list > li:nth-of-type(odd) {
		align-self: start;
		transform: translateX(-3rem);
		border-radius: var(--radius-m) 0px var(--radius-m) var(--radius-m);
	}
	.timeline-6-list > li:nth-of-type(even) {
    align-self: end;
		transform: translateX(3rem);
		border-radius: 0px var(--radius-m) var(--radius-m) var(--radius-m);
	}
	.timeline-6-list > li::before {
		content: "";
		position: absolute;
		height: 2rem;
		width: 2rem;
		border-radius: 50%;
		background-color: var(--primary-light);
		top: 0px;
	}
	.timeline-6-list > li:nth-child(odd)::before {
		transform: translate(50%, -50%);
		right: -3rem;
	}
	.timeline-6-list > li:nth-child(even)::before {
		transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
		left: -3rem;
	}
	.timeline-6-card .timeline-6-card__date {
		position: absolute;
		top: -3rem;
		color: var(--primary-dark)
	}
	.timeline-6-list > li:hover::before {
		background-color: var(--primary);
    transition: ease 2s;
	}
}
  
  @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
	.timeline-6-list {
		align-items: flex-end;
	}
  
  .timeline-6-list:before {
		content: "";
		position: absolute;
		top: .8rem;
		left: 0%;
		transform: translateX(-50%);
		width: .2rem;
		height: 100%;
		background-color: var(--primary-light);
	}
    
  .timeline-6-list > li {
		width: 95%;
    position:relative;
	}
  
  .timeline-6-list > li::before {
		content: "";
		position: absolute;
		height: 2rem;
		width: 2rem;
		border-radius: 50%;
		background-color: var(--primary-light);
		top: 0px;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
		left: -5.2%;

	}
  
}

</style>
